unit_goal_source.description: Exact ready contract/path and baseline used for the current unit.

unit_residuals.description: Current PR/slice contract clauses not covered at this checkpoint. Raw mode: any entry blocks; adjudicated: residuals mirror the blocker rulings (artifacts/verdict.md).

goal_residuals.description: Frozen run-goal clauses still open after this honest slice. They require continuation but do not block this slice.

goal_complete.description: True only when goal_residuals is empty and end-to-end goal acceptance is proven.

coverage.description: One row per TRACED obligation of the unit inside the review boundary (docs/process/rules/review.md REV-4): every contract `## Fault matrix` line, every Acceptance/Parity clause, every public API entry point the diff adds or changes, every frozen oracle/golden artifact — each carrying its trace. Untraced rows raise no coverage row.

row.description: Obligation, quoted or tightly paraphrased from its source.

trace.description: The obligation's declared trace copied from the contract row (RDY-3): I#, scenario, ADR-NNNN (a rule-id-only trace such as REV-7 is a note and raises no row, RDY-3); a public API entry or frozen artifact traces to the clause/ADR introducing it. Several are joined with '+'.

status.description: pass: a committed RED discriminates it (a plausible wrong implementation fails); weak: a carrier exists but a named plausible wrong implementation passes while violating the obligation AS DECLARED (lossy/inexact assertion, non-discriminating fixture, absent count/order/identity check the trace target states) — advisory, report-only (REV-4); a mutant beyond the declared clause is a concern, not weak; missing: no carrier — blocks.

citation.description: file:line of the carrier, or of the obligation source when missing.

note.description: Why weak/missing, referencing the backing finding; empty for pass.

axes.description: One entry per rifty-review rubric axis, in rubric order.

severity.description: blocker: violates the cited authority or a traced obligation has no carrier; concern: advisory (weak evidence, deeper mutant, hardening, premise doubt, taste) — report-only, NOTE under reception (REV-3, REV-12); nit: style.

authority.description: For blockers: the violated DECLARED authority (REV-2) — an invariant I#, a `## User scenario` line, a traced unit row (e.g. `Acceptance 3 → I3`), an active ADR-NNNN, named baseline behavior, or one of the rules REV-2 lists as blocker-capable (AGENTS.md §Fidelity, REV-7, REV-11, REV-10 axis 3); any other rule id is a concern. A blocker without one is invalid. Empty for concern/nit.
